title: Arra të Mbushura me Fik Walnut Stuffed Figs (with Fig Syrup)
hookLine: Global-inspired arra të mbushura me fik walnut stuffed figs (with fig syrup) with 4 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Whisk & Combine Base Ingredients
steps.instructionTemplate: Cut off the hard bits of stalk and then cut the figs in half length ways. Place the figs in a small frying pan / saute pan with the cut side face up and add the water around them. Incorporate {m53406_1} and {m53406_2} smoothly until evenly distributed.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure figs first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Fold In Flavorings & Mix-Ins
steps.instructionTemplate: Leave the figs on a medium heat to cook through, once they become soft remove them from the pan and place onto a serving dish. This will take around 10 - 15 minutes. In the pan there will be a red water juice left from the figs. Add the sugar while remaining on a medium heat. Stir continuously for a couple of minutes until the juice has turned to a thick syrup. Remove from the heat.

steps.title: Combine Wet & Dry Smoothly
steps.instructionTemplate: Fold {m53406_3} and {m53406_4} into the base in two additions using gentle strokes until glossy and uniform with zero dry pockets. Avoid overmixing so the final texture stays light and tender.

steps.title: Cool, Garnish & Serve
steps.instructionTemplate: Push one half of walnut into every fig and then drizzle the syrup over the top. Serve warm or cooled. Plate into 4 generous servings while the flavors and textures are at their peak, and store any leftovers covered.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Measure aromatics and syrups before heating so timing stays crisp and your glaze hits glossy perfection.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 8 mins!
